name: Kestrel Perch Berries
description: In Ithaca, NY, Kestrel Perch Berries raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, and Blackberries on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
